_doc: Orthographic camera of the cookhouse: elevation 46 deg and yaw 5 deg, steeper and squarer than the courtyard's so that a long room shows its floor and not only its walls. The frame is width_m wide; center_px is where the world origin lands in the 1536 x 1024 still (2.03 m left of the centre and 1.42 m below it), so the kitchen and the larder fill the frame.
